consequence.statement: Installing 0.16.0 can fail with 'spec.conversion.webhookClientConfig: Forbidden: should not be set when strategy is not set to Webhook'.
consequence.remediation: Use 0.16.1 instead of 0.16.0 on your installation path; the guide says 0.16.1 should fix this.

assertion.statement: The 0.16.0 troubleshooting guide says installing 0.16.0 can fail with "spec.conversion.webhookClientConfig: Forbidden: should not be set when strategy is not set to Webhook", and that 0.16.1 should be used instead because it fixes this.

proposal.undeterminedReason: subject: The prose gives only an error message and a workaround (use 0.16.1). It does not name the setting, field or object that changed. The rendered diff shows spec.conversion removed from the chart's CRDs, but no source text says this causes the error.; change: The evidence does not say what changed in 0.16.0 to cause the Forbidden error. It only says to use 0.16.1 instead.; applicability: The evidence does not say which installations hit the error (for example, upgrades from a given version, or whether the chart installs the CRDs). It only refers to 'your installation path'.
